verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe CSV/XLSX/XLS import with column-to-field mapping, duplicate detection, and error handling where errors are highlighted (in yellow) and must be fixed directly in the UI rather than silently dropped, plus guidance on referencing related records via unique fields (id/email/domain) to avoid mismatches. This directly addresses field mapping, validation, and preventing silent data loss during import of contacts/deals objects. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that rows are never silently lost in practice, and no explicit mention of a post-import summary/report of skipped rows.
